VIKI Agent / Guide

6 min read · 3 sections

Sessions and data

VIKI Agent shows Claude Code conversations from the CLI's transcript files. The app keeps its own preferences and recovery records separately. Knowing which copy holds what matters before an export, reset or move.

On this page
  1. 01Conversations and local state
  2. 02Finding and exporting a conversation
  3. 03Backups, import and Reset

01Conversations and local state

Claude Code writes and removes conversation transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/. VIKI Agent reads them to build the session list, history, search and Between chats. It does not keep a second transcript database.

  • Closing or archiving a chat in VIKI Agent
    does not preserve its transcript.
  • Removed transcripts
    if Claude Code removes a transcript, that conversation disappears from the list and search and cannot be resumed there. If you had only archived it, VIKI Agent also deletes that archive label, unless it is a profile chat. Otherwise it is listed under Conversations whose record is missing, where Remove deletes its labels; a profile chat that has not started is listed there with Open instead.
  • Archiving
    hides a chat from the active sidebar list. You can archive a listed chat even when it shows "This conversation is unavailable."

Warning

Claude Code's cleanupPeriodDays setting controls its cleanup; the documented default is 30 days after last activity. Export conversations you need to keep before that cleanup.

For Between chats, VIKI Agent also reads Claude Code's list of running sessions in ~/.claude/sessions to name the chat a message came from. It reads only the .json files there.

The app's own data folder

The app's own data folder holds app.sqlite3, images used by drafts and submitted turns, logs and a browser profile. The Data locations view shows the active paths.

The database holds workspace registrations, settings, session labels and bookmarks, sealed drafts and submitted text, recorded card answers, queues, routines, task records, Bot usage counts and other app state. It is not a copy of the Claude Code conversations.

Default app-data folders are:

PlatformApp-data folder
Windows%LOCALAPPDATA%\viki-agent
macOS~/Library/Application Support/viki-agent
Linux$XDG_DATA_HOME/viki-agent, or ~/.local/share/viki-agent when XDG_DATA_HOME is unset or relative

VIKI_DATA_DIR can select another app-data folder, outside vaults, ~/.claude and ~/.codex.

To make a cold copy:

  1. Close VIKI Agent.
  2. Copy the entire folder together, including SQLite sidecars and, on macOS and Linux, sealing-key-id.

Sealed values depend on the Windows account or on the matching macOS/Linux keychain item, so copying the files alone may not make those values readable under another account or path.

Bot usage log

The database also keeps a Bot usage log: each Bot chat's calls as token counts and ids, never message text. A capture runs at the end of each chat turn and before each usage dashboard or CLI read; closing VIKI Agent stops a running capture before its next write, and what it had not yet written is read again next time.

  • Outlives transcript cleanup
    a logged call stays even after Claude Code's own cleanup (30 days by default, above) removes the transcript it came from. See Bots for how long VIKI Agent itself keeps a call.
  • Not a Reset category
    Reset does not clear it; see Reset.
  • Not exported
    Export settings and Export diagnostics omit it.

Bot learning

For each Bot, the database also keeps what Learning needs, never message text:

  • Episodes
    each finished Bot turn's time, outcome, kind of chat and tool names, the newest 2,000 per Bot.
  • Web and MCP marks
    which chats read web or MCP content, until you clear one.
  • Runs and proposals
    the latest 200 runs per Bot and their proposals, each proposal's text sealed like drafts; a run with a proposal still waiting is kept. At most 100 proposals wait per Bot.
  • Use counts
    how often each memory record was recalled and judged helpful or harmful.

The memory records themselves are notes in the vault's memory/ folder. Removing a Bot, or unregistering its vault, deletes these rows; Reset does not, and Export settings and Export diagnostics omit them.

Magpie data

The bundled Magpie process keeps its configuration, provider keys, usage records, history and caches under the app-data folder's magpie/ directory. The installed app also extracts its verified Magpie executable into that directory's runtime/ folder. Magpie owns its data files; its provider keys do not use VIKI Agent's encrypted connection store. Its own logs and any agent configuration it manages can be outside that directory.

VIKI Agent settings exports and settings reset do not include Magpie data. Use Magpie's own controls to manage its accounts, history and backups. To remove its local data, close VIKI Agent and delete only the app-data folder's magpie/ directory. This does not undo agent settings Magpie changed or remove accounts from other applications.

Drafts and images

Drafts and submitted turns use local sealed storage.

  • Claude Code's image copy
    when an upload is sent, Claude Code also keeps its own image copy. Clearing a draft or send history in VIKI Agent does not clear that copy.
  • Unused images
    VIKI Agent may delete an image once no draft or sent turn uses it, so save any attachment you need elsewhere before a reset.

VIKI Agent's own window profile

VIKI Agent's own window keeps a separate Chromium profile outside this app-data folder, in Electron's own per-OS location:

PlatformProfile folder
Windows%APPDATA%\VIKI Agent
macOS~/Library/Application Support/VIKI Agent
Linux~/.config/VIKI Agent, or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/VIKI Agent when that is set

It holds that window's own caches and its saved microphone choice. Reset does not clear it; delete it yourself while VIKI Agent is closed.

02Finding and exporting a conversation

Use Ctrl+K (⌘+K on macOS) to search the listed transcripts.

  • Search covers
    session titles, your messages and finished replies.
  • Search omits
    tool input, tool output and thinking. It also excludes the Other session group.
  • Partial results
    large or unreadable transcripts can produce partial results.
  • Transcripts larger than 256 MiB
    read in bounded windows. Old content may be unavailable in the app's history or search even while the file exists.

Open a chat's own tools to Export Markdown or export a JSON archive with attachments.

  • Cut text
    if the window says a long prompt's displayed text was cut, inspect the prompt before relying on an archive. Use the full submission or transcript view first.
  • Importing an archive
    opens a read-only copy for reference.
  • Settings export and diagnostics export
    contain no conversation transcript.

03Backups, import and Reset

The Data view's vault backup copies a vault's notes, not every file in it.

  • Preview
    review the preview's note count, skipped items and instruction files.
  • Destination
    must be outside registered vaults, the app data folder, ~/.claude and ~/.codex.
  • Protection
    the backup is not encrypted, and a folder on the same disk does not protect against losing that disk.
  • Restore
    verifies a backup into a new folder and registers it read-only. It does not overwrite an existing vault.

Settings and diagnostics files

Export settings and Export diagnostics each produce a JSON file after a preview.

  • Diagnostics
    can include selected local facts such as paths, settings, workspace registrations or a log tail.
  • Redaction
    VIKI Agent applies a redaction filter, but the output may still describe your machine or work. Inspect the file before sharing it.
  • Import settings
    previews and validates settings values. It does not import transcripts, vault notes or routines.

An import preview applies only to the settings as they were when you made it. If settings change before Apply, make a new preview and select the values again. Reloading settings alone does not renew the earlier import preview.

Reset

Reset requires typing RESET and acts only on selected app categories: settings, drafts, send history, approval records, chat-only scratch files and the browser profile.

  • Refusals
    the running browser profile is refused, and a scratch folder in use is refused.
  • Retained items
    an in-flight submission or an answer recorded during this launch can be retained, so the result may say partial.
  • Other app data
    other data kept by VIKI Agent, including routines, queues, task records and bookmarks, is outside these Reset categories. Use Delete all decision history or delete chosen rows under Data on the Decision page to clear Decision data.

Reset does not erase Claude Code transcripts or registered vaults. Reset does not undo changes already made to files in a vault.

Caution

Reset is irreversible for the rows it removes. Export any conversation you need and make a cold copy of the app-data folder before resetting.

  • Clearing drafts
    can orphan an attachment held only by a draft.
  • Clearing send history
    can remove the app's recoverable copy of sent text and an image's original name; its local image copy can then expire.

See Using VIKI Agent for the controls and Troubleshooting for safe recovery when storage cannot open.
